mapper.select: SELECT member.id, member.user_id, app_user.email, app_user.display_name, member.role, member.status, member.joined_at, app_user.last_login_at, member.created_at FROM organization_member member JOIN app_user ON app_user.id = member.user_id WHERE member.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND member.id = #{memberId} LIMIT 1

SELECT organization.id, organization.slug, organization.name, organization.timezone, organization.locale, organization.plan_code, organization.status, count(member.id) FILTER (WHERE member.status <> 'LEFT') AS total_members, count(member.id) FILTER (WHERE member.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active_members, count(member.id) FILTER (WHERE member.status = 'ACTIVE' AND member.role IN ('OWNER', 'ADMIN')) AS admin_members, organization.created_at, organization.updated_at FROM organization LEFT JOIN organization_member member ON member.organization_id = organization.id WHERE organization.id = #{organizationId} GROUP BY organization.id
SELECT count(*) FROM app_user WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_user_credential (user_id, password_hash, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{passwordHash}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE organization SET name = #{name}, timezone = #{timezone}, locale = #{locale}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{organizationId}
